tasks.title: Summarize in exactly 10 words
tasks.prompt:
Summarize the following passage in exactly 10 words. Preserve all numbers and names.

Passage:

"On May 5, 2026, the company announced a profit of $5 million."

Your summary must be exactly 10 words.
tasks.reference: May 5, 2026 company announced profit of $5 million today

tasks.title: Summarize in at most 15 words
tasks.prompt:
Summarize the following passage in at most 15 words. Keep the key numbers and names.

Passage:

"The project started on January 1, 2026 and ended on December 31, 2026, costing $2.4 million."

Your summary must be 15 words or fewer.
tasks.reference: Project January 1, 2026 to December 31, 2026 cost $2.4 million

tasks.title: Summarize in exactly 20 words with required phrases
tasks.prompt:
Summarize the following passage in exactly 20 words. Must include the date, the company name, and the profit figure.

Passage:

"On March 15, 2026, TechCorp announced quarterly profits of $12.5 million, exceeding expectations."

Your summary must be exactly 20 words and include "March 15, 2026", "TechCorp", and "$12.5 million".
tasks.reference: On March 15, 2026 TechCorp announced quarterly profits of $12.5 million which exceeded analyst expectations by a large margin today

tasks.title: Summarize in exactly 25 words
tasks.prompt:
Summarize the following passage in exactly 25 words. Keep the key numbers and names.

Passage:

"The city council approved the budget on April 10, 2026, allocating $8.7 million for schools and $3.2 million for infrastructure."

Your summary must be exactly 25 words.
tasks.reference: On April 10, 2026, city council approved budget allocating $8.7 million for schools and $3.2 million for infrastructure to improve education and community facilities today.

tasks.title: Summarize in exactly 30 words with multiple constraints
tasks.prompt:
Summarize the following passage in exactly 30 words. Must include the date, the product name, and the price.

Passage:

"On July 22, 2026, the new gadget \"GizmoX\" was launched at a price of $99.99."

Your summary must be exactly 30 words and include "July 22, 2026", "GizmoX", and "$99.99".
tasks.reference: On July 22, 2026, the new gadget GizmoX was launched at a price of $99.99, attracting attention from consumers and media worldwide due to its innovative features in the market.

tasks.title: Summarize in at most 20 words
tasks.prompt:
Summarize the following passage in at most 20 words. Keep the key numbers and names.

Passage:

"The research study conducted from January 2026 to June 2026 found a 15% increase in efficiency after the new algorithm was implemented."

Your summary must be 20 words or fewer.
tasks.reference: Study January 2026 to June 2026 found 15% increase after new algorithm
